news.title: Mother of teen shot by Henry County police to speak out
news.summary: The mother of a 16-year-old boy killed by Henry County police plans to speak out.

news.title: 2 Cobb County brothers reported missing found safe; third child also located

news.title: 'So much confusion': Wife of gas station employee killed in Atlanta wants answers as family mourns loss
news.summary: Eniyew Yehuala was shot and killed last Tuesday while working at a Chevron gas station on Cascade Ave.

news.summary: Three people found inside a business that had been broken into were arrested, Clayton County police say.

news.summary: Authorities are investigating the death of 36-year-old Allison Lynn Anderson after a 911 caller found her body Monday morning in the yard of an abandoned home.

news.summary: Three boys who were reported as missing runaways have been found in Atlanta.

news.title: Rapper Rod Wave indicted on gun, drug charges after Atlanta arrest

news.title: Motorcyclist dies in Tuesday crash with pickup truck in Kennesaw
news.summary: A 20-year-old Woodstock motorcyclist died Tuesday afternoon after a pickup truck turned left into his path at a busy Kennesaw intersection, Cobb County police said.

news.title: Woodstock outlet mall Nike theft uncovered $39,000 retail crime ring across six counties: DA
news.summary: The women were linked to 38 thefts at five retailers between November 2022 and August 2024, according to the Cherokee County District Attorney's Office.
